public.title: The DDP Heist
public.setup: On 2026-09-20, between 06:30 and 08:00, a limited‑edition smartwatch was taken from the display case at the DDP exhibition hall in Seoul.

suspects.name: Min-jun Kim
suspects.alibi: I was driving my car on DDP front road from 06:10 to 08:15, listening to the radio, then went straight to work.

suspects.name: Soo-yeon Park
suspects.alibi: I bought a coffee at a Myeongdong café at 07:00, receipt shows purchase at 07:03, then walked to Jongno.

suspects.name: Ji-hoon Lee
suspects.alibi: I exercised at the Gangnam Fitness Center from 07:20 to 07:50; my gym log records entry at 07:22 and exit at 07:48.

public.brief: One of these alibis collides with a real public fact in Seoul this week. Search the live web, pick your evidence, and name the thief.

hidden.why_impossible: DDP front road was closed to all vehicles from 06:00 to 08:25 on 2026-09-20, so driving there during that period could not have occurred.
hidden.fact: DDP 앞 도로는 2026-09-20 오전 6시부터 8시25분까지 차량 통행이 전면 통제된다.
hidden.fact_en: DDP front road is closed to all vehicles from 06:00 to 08:25 on 2026-09-20.
hidden.quote: 행사로 인해 20일 오전 DDP부터 광화문 일대 주요 도로가 순차 통제된다. DDP 앞 도로는 오전 6시부터 8시25분까지 통제되며, 율곡터널 북측은 행사 시설 설치와 철거를 위해 자정부터 오전 11시까지 전면 통제한다.

verdicts.reason: The fact states that DDP front road was closed to all vehicles from 06:00 to 08:25 on 2026-09-20. The alibi claims driving on that road from 06:10 to 08:15, which directly contradicts the closure, making it impossible.

The fact only restricts vehicles on DDP front road from 06:00 to 08:25 on 2026-09-20. The alibi describes buying coffee in Myeongdong and walking to Jongno, which does not involve being on DDP front road or using a vehicle there, so it remains possible.

The alibi places the person at Gangnam Fitness Center during 07:20–07:50, which is a different location from DDP front road. The fact only restricts vehicles on DDP front road from 06:00 to 08:25; being elsewhere does not violate this restriction, so the alibi is not strictly impossible.
